notes.title: Paddle Battle - New Reduced Price!
notes.notes: Full transparency - It seems Paddle Battle was priced too high from the start. I an effort to get the game into the hands of more players, the priced has been cut by more than 50%! There is no point of utilizing early access if there aren't people playing the game to provide feedback!
